content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Radio lyrics are passwords meant for me.
Broadcasts target broad audiences. Which lyric felt uniquely addressed to you?
They used my nickname twice in one hour.
Many nicknames are common. If you monitor two other stations at the same time and note similar coincidences, that tests the personal-target idea.
I usually listen to just one.
Parallel listening—two streams—helps see whether it’s station-specific or general.
What if only one station has it?
Then check that station’s playlist or lyric database to see how often the nickname appears overall.
